town_description: Lohardaga is the administrative headquarters of Lohardaga district in southwest Jharkhand, about 75 km west of Ranchi. The district was carved out of Ranchi in 1983; the town was the commissionary headquarters of Chotanagpur in the early 1900s. Lohardaga is known as the 'Bauxite Town' for the rich bauxite mines around it, and the ancient Khakhparta (Khekparta) Shiva temple, a protected 9th-10th century monument, lies about 8 km away.

travel.road: Connected by road to Ranchi, Gumla and Latehar via state highways
